title: Sepsis Early-Warning System

blueprintSignals.name: Lactate and trend
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Use result time not draw time

blueprintSignals.name: Missingness pattern
blueprintSignals.definition: counts of vitals measured in last 4h
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Treat as signal only if the process is stable across sites

blueprintSignals.name: Vital-sign slope 3h
blueprintSignals.definition: change in heart rate, respiratory rate and systolic pressure over 3 hours
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Use charted times and carry values forward only from past readings

blueprintSignals.name: Reading density 4h
blueprintSignals.definition: number of vitals charted in the last 4 hours
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Charting habits differ between wards, so check stability per site before trusting it

blueprintSignals.name: Clinician order frequency
blueprintSignals.definition: count and timing of lactate orders and blood-culture draws
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: High-risk proxy leakage: exclude it, or use it only as a missed-escalation safety net and report results with and without it

label: For "Sepsis Early-Warning System": Alert clinicians hours before sepsis onset from streaming vitals and labs, with alert burden low enough that nurses keep trusting it. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Labels set after the intervention are partly caused by it.
